children: Christian Berlin has been appointed as the new CEO for Elanders’ subsidiary LGI. Christian brings more than 20 years of experience in the logistics industry and has previously held several leadership positions in operations, business development and commercial functions across Germany, Europe, and Asia.

Christian will assume the position and become member of Elanders’ Group Management in 2027. The commencement date will be announced once finalized. Florian Beck will remain CEO of LGI until Christian Berlin assumes his position.

“I am very pleased that Christian has accepted the role as CEO of LGI. He has extensive experience of driving growth with focus on developing advanced value-added services which will be valuable for Elanders”, says Florian Beck, President and CEO of Elanders.

“I am looking forward to joining LGI and Elanders. LGI has a strong position in the market, built on deep logistics expertise, close customer relationships and a highly experienced organization. I look forward to working with the team to build on these strengths, further develop our value-added services and create sustainable growth for our customers and Elanders”, says Christian Berlin.
As of this change Elanders’ Group Management will consist of the following persons:
Florian Beck, President and Group CEO
Åsa Vilsson, Group CFO
Christian Berlin, responsible for Supply Chain Solutions (LGI)
Charles Ickes, Group COO and responsible for Supply Chain Solutions (Bergen Logistics)
Simon Sim, responsible for Supply Chain Solutions (Mentor Media)
Tim Bloch, responsible for Supply Chain Solutions in the United Kingdom
Sven Burkhard, responsible for Print & Packaging Solutions
For further information, please contact:
Florian Beck, President and Group CEO, telephone: +46 31 750 07 50
Åsa Vilsson, Group CFO, telephone: +46 31 750 07 50
About Elanders

Elanders is a global logistics company offering a broad service range of integrated solutions within supply chain management. The business is mainly operated through the two business areas Supply Chain Solutions and Print & Packaging Solutions. The Group has approximately 7,000 employees and operates in around 20 countries on four continents. The most important markets are China, Germany, Singapore, Sweden, the UK and the USA. The customers are divided into six segments according to their respective business; Automotive, Electronics, Fashion, Health Care, Industrial and Other.
